modelDefinition.name: PlexUserAccount
modelDefinition.description: Vendor-shaped projection of UserAccountDTO from /mdm/v1/user-accounts. Generated from the PLEX dictionary 2026-08-05, not hand-written. Read-only evidence: every field is nullable because a vendor's required flag describes their write contract, not what their read endpoint returns. Harmonization happens in the hub tenant.

fields.name: id
fields.description: Primary id (== dedupeKey). Ours, not the vendor's.

fields.name: userId
fields.description: The User ID as seen on Plex login screens

fields.name: firstName
fields.description: Vendor field `firstName`.

fields.name: middleName
fields.description: Vendor field `middleName`.

fields.name: lastName
fields.description: Vendor field `lastName`.

fields.name: position
fields.description: Position or title within the organization

fields.name: email
fields.description: Vendor field `email`.

fields.name: department
fields.description: Vendor field `department`.

fields.name: externalId
fields.description: Native key in the source system. Half of the upsert key, so a re-extract overwrites rather than duplicates.

fields.name: sourceSystemId
fields.description: FK to ExternalSystem — WHICH instance of this ERP said so. Two sites running the same vendor are two systems, and their keys collide by construction.

fields.name: sourceSystem
fields.description:
The registered source system this row came from. A REAL relation, not a bare id: it makes `row.sourceSystem { name }` traversable and makes the platform reject a source system that does not exist — which is the difference between catching a mistyped system on the first row and discovering it after a million rows have landed under a name nobody recognises.

     One-way by design. ExternalSystem is a platform/ACE model this generator does not own, so it gets no reverse collection — and a collection of several thousand vendor models hanging off one registry row would be unusable anyway.

fields.name: sourceUrl
fields.description: Collection endpoint this row was read from, so a suspect field can be traced to the contract that produced it.

fields.name: sourceVersion
fields.description: Dictionary stamp this model was generated from. A vendor schema change shows up here before it shows up as a bug.

fields.name: syncedAt
fields.description: When this row was last read from the source.

fields.name: rawPayload
fields.description: The verbatim vendor record. Stays in the SPOKE tenant — feature bundles cross to the hub, raw payloads never do.

fields.name: dedupeKey
fields.description: sourceSystemId:externalId — the idempotency key.
